panels.title: Decode
panels.description: Tokens decoded per second across all streams, counted as the work happens.

panels.title: Prefill
panels.description: Prompt tokens computed per second (not restored from cache).

panels.description: Share of prompt tokens restored from kept prompt states rather than prefilled.

panels.description: Refused plus failed requests.

panels.title: Per-stream decode speed
panels.description: One stream's decode rate on finished requests (1 / mean time per output token).

panels.description: Share of speculative draft tokens kept, on finished requests.

panels.title: Queued requests by reason
panels.description: Why queued requests are waiting; empty means nothing queued.

panels.title: Prompt cache
panels.description: Retained prompt states and the storage they hold.

panels.description: Tokens of KV pages. Reclaimable pages are held only by the prompt store and can be evicted.

panels.title: Streams' KV window usage
panels.description: Tokens in a stream's cache over its context window.

panels.description: Per 5 minutes.

panels.description: Per 5 minutes.

panels.description: Per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: MemAvailable of the unified pool. Red is under the memory guard's 2.5 GiB stop line.
